body:
Split DEADWEIGHT's account_rules.prn (display-name validation) into a region-free scalar module (account_rules_scalar.prn) that can target C+Java+TypeScript, plus the original region-dependent is-valid-display-name (C only, real PARENA emitter gap confirmed on both Java and TS). Added a genuinely new rule (min-password-len/is-valid-password-length) closing a real, found-live duplication: the '8+ characters' password rule was hand-copied identically into apps/gui/main.c, MainActivity.java, and web/src/account.ts with zero shared source. Wired into DEADWEIGHT's C client (core/account_rules.c is now actually linked into dw_gui for the first time -- it was generated in a prior session but never added to the build) and Android's MainActivity.java. Verified: new C test (7 checks), new Java brute-force test (254 checks, added to BUILD.bazel), full existing DEADWEIGHT suite stays green (24097+9941+806k+ checks), real javac --release 8 compile against the Android stub jar.

⚓ ☃
title: New Java/TS-targetable account_rules_scalar.prn module, fixing an unlinked C account-rules file and a real 3-way hand-duplicated password check
